title: Kāpiti Island terrain depicted with LINZ LiDAR, 2024
credit: Vallee (creator), using LiDAR supplied by LINZ, map labels from Topomap and QGIS/aerialOD cartography. Display derivative resized to WebP; original preserved.
altText: LiDAR-derived relief map of Kāpiti Island showing terrain, vegetation-shaped relief and mapped place names.
caption: Detailed shaded-relief map of Kāpiti Island produced in 2024 by Vallee using publicly available LINZ LiDAR data, QGIS, and aerialOD shading.
context: This map is a modern, real LiDAR-derived terrain product. It shows terrain detail possible using high-density elevation measurements; it is not a scan of an early New Zealand LiDAR flight.
derivativesNote: Local original stored unchanged; WebP display width up to 1600 pixels and thumbnail width up to 720 pixels, resized without cropping.
